_comment: Seed fixture for the rca-evidence-cards-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000004029 (free-htmx port — tenth port after
activity-log-htmx, MR !2334 / ka-0000004584; related-tickets-htmx,
MR !2346 / ka-0000005540; header-incident-summary-htmx, MR !2347 /
ka-0000005304; reproduction-steps-htmx, MR !2350 / ka-0000007835;
reporter-info-htmx, ka-0000004065; event-timeline-htmx,
ka-0000000243; ai-recommended-actions-htmx, ka-0000000272;
fix-available-pending-branch-htmx, ka-0000005506; vm-sparklines-htmx,
ka-0000000715; source-code-analysis-htmx, ka-0000006619). Strategy
A — port-then-soak: the rca-evidence-cards-htmx slug lives alongside
the Go-coded `rca-evidence-cards` slug rather than replacing it.
Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: rca-evidence-cards-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/rca-evidence-cards-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `rca-evidence-cards`
renderer at widgets_phase5.go::renderRCAEvidenceCards —
cards[] of {id, headline, detail, source_kind, source_label,
confidence, language, code, drilldown_markdown, drilldown_title,
open_mezmo, open_mr, ide_path, ide_line, open_jira}. Five intentional
parity gaps vs. the Go path, all documented in
TestRCAEvidenceCardsParity:
1. Chroma syntax highlighting. The Go path runs each card's
`code` field through the shared codeHighlighter (chroma,
github-dark theme, server-side, cached). The htmx template
body has no Go-side hook into chroma, so the rendered <pre>
carries plain escaped text rather than chroma's token spans.
Producers cutting an rca-evidence-cards-htmx widget-instance
get readable code without the colourised tokens; the existing
CSS `.ii-w-rca-code` chrome still applies. Same gap as
source-code-analysis-htmx.
2. Confidence normalisation. The Go path runs payload.confidence
through confidenceBand() — numbers >=0.8 → "high", >=0.5 →
"medium", else "low"; strings get trimmed/lower-cased and
validated against {high, medium, low}. The htmx template
renders the field verbatim, so producers MUST emit confidence
as a pre-banded lower-case string ("high"/"medium"/"low").
A numeric score would render verbatim and violate the D2
rule that numbers must not surface. Same gap as
ai-recommended-actions-htmx.
3. Source-kind normalisation. The Go path lower-cases
payload.source_kind before emitting `data-source-kind="…"`.
The htmx template renders the field verbatim, so producers MUST
emit source_kind as a pre-lower-cased string (e.g. "mezmo",
"victoria-metrics", "gitlab") for the Phase-1 source-chip CSS
palette to match.
4. Action buttons. The Go renderer constructs
`<button class="ii-action-btn">` elements via OpenMezmoAction /
OpenMRAction / OpenIDEAction / OpenJiraAction descriptors keyed
off open_mezmo / open_mr / ide_path / open_jira. The htmx
template body has no Go-side hook for button construction, so
the four button-construction fields are silently ignored. The
`<div class="ii-w-rca-actions">` wrapper is present but empty.
Same gap as ai-recommended-actions-htmx /
header-incident-summary-htmx / source-code-analysis-htmx;
blocks on a future template-side button-builder fn (research
5. Drill-down drawer. The Go renderer pre-renders
payload.drilldown_markdown via goldmark and emits a
`<button class="ii-w-rca-drill">` plus a `<template>` carrying
the rendered HTML. The htmx template has no goldmark helper in
scope and no template-side button construction, so the drawer
button + template pair is omitted entirely — the
drilldown_markdown / drilldown_title fields are silently
ignored. Producers who want a drawer should keep using the
`rca-evidence-cards` Go slug.

fields.template_source:
{{- $cards := index .Payload "cards" -}} {{if $cards}}
    {{range $cards}}
  1. {{if .source_kind}} {{if .source_label}}{{.source_label}}{{else}}{{.source_kind}}{{end}} {{end}} {{if .headline}}

    {{.headline}}

    {{end}} {{if .confidence}}{{.confidence}} confidence{{end}}
    {{if .detail}}

    {{.detail}}

    {{end}} {{if .code}}
    {{.code}}
    {{end}}
    2. {{end}}
{{else}}

No RCA evidence collected.

{{end}}
